page.layout: One text column, full page height. Running head "NOTÆ." at top left with page number 239 at top right. No marginal notes. Right of the column is blank, apart from stains and show-through. Bottom: signature "I i" at left, catchword at right under the last line.

main_text.p: ut Sharestanius, vel اهنان فعل العبن الي الله ut at-tribuatur actio hominis Deo, ut Author Al Mawakef, & Ebnol Kassai. vocis ergo significatio quæ hic locum habet, ea est quâ idem valet ac الجبر coactio, eritque Aljabarius, ille qui hominem omnia coactam agere statuat; scil. vi decreti divini, à quo inevitabili necessitate ad omnia quæ agit facienda impellitur. Sic Hebræi الجبر vertunt מוכרח Coactum & הכרחה necessitas, coactio, ut videre est in Proleg. Maimonidis ad Pirke Abboth: sec.8. &c. Aljabariorum autem diversas statuunt species, unam الخالصة purorum, qui لا يثبت للعبد فعلا ولا قدرة على الفعل اصلا non af-firmari patiuntur in homine actionem nec potentiam ul-lam ad actionem, vel circa actionem, alteram mediorum qui tribuunt homini قدرة غير مؤثرة potentiam, sed quæ omnino nullam habeat impres-sionem, seu influentiam in actionem. Nam qui asserunt للقدرة الحادثة اثرا ما في الفعل Potentia, in ho-mine producta impressionem quandam in actionem, quam كسبا acquisitionem vocant, hos non vult Sharesta-nius, Aljabarios dici, at Author libri Al Mawakef & Ebnol Kassai, hos etiam Aljabarios medios, i. e. qui medium tuentur sententiam inter الجبر necessitatis af-fertionem, & التفويض omnium ipsi homini permissi-onem, qui attribuunt homini كسبا (ut vocant) ac-quisitionem,

page.notes: Arabic and Hebrew passages are copied from the scan at low resolution. Letters and dots in the Arabic are uncertain in several places, particularly "الخالصة" (the word before "purorum"), "قدرة غير مؤثرة", and the Hebrew "מוכרח" and "הכרחה". They are not marked with [?] because the scan is legible enough to copy, but a check against a higher-resolution image is advisable. The word "Shareftanius" is printed with a long s and has been given as "Sharestanius". Show-through and stains in the right margin have been left out.
